mapper.select: SELECT company.company_id, company.code, company.name FROM company company WHERE company.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_data_scope scope ON scope.scope_id = assignment.data_scope_id LEFT JOIN organization_identity scoped_organization ON scoped_organization.organization_id = scope.organization_id LEFT JOIN employee scoped_employee ON scoped_employee.employee_id = principal.employee_id WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (scope.valid_to IS NULL OR scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND ( (scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND scope.company_id = company.company_id) OR ( scope.scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND scoped_organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' AND scoped_organization.company_id = company.company_id ) OR ( scope.scope_type = 'SELF' AND scoped_employee.company_id = company.company_id ) ) ) ORDER BY company.code, company.name, company.company_id
